source.code:
/-- Mixin class for scalar-multiplication actions with a strictly multiplicative norm, i.e.
`‖r • x‖ = ‖r‖ * ‖x‖`. -/
class NormSMulClass (α β : Type*) [Norm α] [Norm β] [SMul α β] : Prop where
  protected norm_smul (r : α) (x : β) : ‖r • x‖ = ‖r‖ * ‖x‖
